mediators.M_5m_placebo: Maximum single 5-minute bar jump max_{b in 1..12} |dp_5m[b]| (isolated 5-minute shock placebo).
mediators.M_ckpt_primary: Mean absolute price displacement across the four 15-minute checkpoints of hour t->t+60: (1/4) sum_{k=1}^4 |p[t+15k-1] - p[t-1]| (measures persistent multi-quarter-hour non-reversion).
mediators.M_l1_secondary: 60-minute L1 cumulative excursion integral: (1/60) sum_{tau=0}^{59} |p[t+tau] - p[t-1]| (empirical counterpart of summed impulse norm S60).

motivation: Part 22 (2b3794e3) showed that 5-minute net open-interest contractions (LIQ_next) are neither forecast by C3_hat (-0.795 pts) nor mediate C3_hat excursion predictability (-6.8% mediation share). Part 25 directly tests the slow-reversion / multi-minute price-impact persistence mechanism of Theorem thm:sum on 42 untouched test dates, contrasted against a single 5-minute bar jump placebo.

primary_1_forecast_persistence.criterion: delta_R2 > 0, Clark-West one-sided p < 0.025, and 95% date-block bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 (2,000 draws).
primary_1_forecast_persistence.estimand: Out-of-sample delta_R2 of C3_hat for next-hour M_ckpt beyond the 13 baseline controls + symbol fixed effects.

primary_2_mediation_of_excursion.criterion: Mediation share >= 0.50 with 95% date-block bootstrap CI lower bound >= 0.50 (and M_5m_placebo mediation share < 0.50).
primary_2_mediation_of_excursion.estimand: Mediation share 1 - delta_R2(MAE_60 | C3_hat, M_ckpt) / delta_R2(MAE_60 | C3_hat) of C3_hat out-of-sample excursion predictability.

theory_reference: Theorem thm:sum (third-order feedback C3 = kappa^2 eta q - (1-a) kappa amplifies worst-case excursion via multi-minute price-impact persistence and slow book reversion rather than isolated 5-minute jump shocks)
unit: Hourly observations for hours 6..22 UTC (features estimated on [t-360, t); outcomes and mediators measured on [t, t+60)).
